section_summary.extract_value: This study presents the development and validation of a Brazilian adaptation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for young adolescents aged 10-13 years (N=347; 171 male, 176 female). The study confirmed the one-factor structure of the BAS through confirmatory factor analysis and demonstrated adequate validity and reliability, with a significant negative correlation between BAS scores and BMI (r = –.230, p < .001). The adapted scale maintains the same dimensional structure as the original version and is suitable for use with Brazilian adolescent samples.
